page.layout: One page of text, with a woodcut-style initial and a heading at the top. Verse runs down the page, with the catchword "Tandem" at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: MVSARVM DONA. Iac. Lectius, Th. Bezæ, V. C L. S.

p.i: DAVCA tibi è multis populata munera villæ Mittimus, heu lachrymis munera digna meis. Quippe etiam sacro sociati fœdere amici Delicias ruris diripuere mei. Quæ mea, quæq; patris, quæq; olim infeuit avorum Gnaua manus, subito turba reuulsit iners. Hæc mihi visa tamen leuiter iactura ferenda: Acrior in[?]usit pectora nostra dolor. Vna fuit Charitum Musarúmque vna piarum, Culta per & saltus ludere sueta meos. Quin totam hic choreis quondam indulgere cohorte Et memini, & nunquam dememinisse placet. Iam mihi nō Charitū, nō Musarum vlla reperta est, Heu! placitos cunctæ deseruere locos. Sæpe mihi frustra Musa, sæpe augur Apollo, Sæpe vocata Charis nomine quæque suo est. Nempe Caledonios vltra fugisse Britannos, Caucasei ve reor delituisse iugis. Ergo huius mihi causa mali incusatus acerbè est, Alpina insanus qui regit antra puer. Tandem

page.notes: The initial D of DAVCA is a large decorative letter, joined to the first word. The word "infeuit" and "infusit" are uncertain in the scan; "innasit" is read as "in[?]usit". The line "Mittimus, heu" is broken at "di-" with a printed hyphen. The faint mirrored text at the top right is show-through and is not transcribed.
